paragraphs: Ontario Tech University (formerly University of Ontario Institute of Technology) is a public research university in Oshawa, Ontario, founded in 2002. It is Canada's only university built from the ground up around technology, offering over 75 programs in engineering, business, science, health, education, and the social sciences.

Ontario Tech is particularly renowned for its programs in cybersecurity, nuclear engineering, software engineering, game development, and health informatics. The university has a strong co-op program with industry partners in Oshawa, Toronto, and across Ontario.

Located in the Durham Region east of Toronto, Ontario Tech offers students proximity to both Toronto's vast job market (40 minutes by GO Train) and more affordable housing in Oshawa. The university's emphasis on applied technology aligns closely with Durham Region's automotive, nuclear energy, and technology sectors.

International students at Ontario Tech benefit from a welcoming international community, co-op and research opportunities, and access to Ontario's technology employment market. Graduates qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program pathways.
paragraphsRu: Ontario Tech University — государственный исследовательский университет в Ошаве, Онтарио, основанный в 2002 году. Единственный университет Канады, построенный вокруг технологий с самого начала.
Особую известность приобрели программы Cybersecurity, Nuclear Engineering, Software Engineering, Game Development и Health Informatics. Сильная co-op программа с отраслевыми партнёрами.
Расположенный в регионе Дарем к востоку от Торонто, Ontario Tech предлагает близость к огромному рынку труда Торонто (40 минут на GO Train) и доступное жильё.
Иностранные студенты получают право на Post-Graduation Work Permit и программу Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program.
